source_caption:
🎬 Sidelined: The QB and Me (2024)

Sidelined: The QB and Me follows Dallas Bryan, a talented high school dancer determined to earn a scholarship and pursue her dreams of becoming a professional performer. Her carefully planned future takes an unexpected turn when she meets Drayton Lahey, the school’s popular and charming star quarterback. Despite their different backgrounds and ambitions, the two develop a powerful attraction that quickly grows into a complicated romance. As their feelings deepen, Dallas struggles to balance her relationship with her dedication to dance, while Drayton faces pressures surrounding his football career and family expectations. With emotional moments, romantic tension, and unexpected challenges, the film explores young love, ambition, personal growth, and the importance of following your dreams without losing yourself along the way.

🎭 Genre: Romance • Drama • Coming-of-Age

⭐ IMDb: 5.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 39m • TV-14

🎥 Director: Justin Wu

✍️ Writer: Crystal Ferreiro

📺 Where to Watch: Tubi in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Sidelined: The QB and Me is a 2024 American romantic comedy film based on The QB and Me novel by Tay Marley. Directed by Justin Wu and written by Crystal Ferreiro and Mary Gulino, the film stars Siena Agudong, Noah Beck, Drew Ray Tanner, James Van Der Beek and Deborah Cox. The film was released on November 29, 2024 on Tubi. A sequel, Sidelined 2: Intercepted, was released on November 27, 2025.
